changed_blockers_rechecked.LINUX-PRESSURE-CRITERION: Addressed in plan: two strict PSI reads over the same one-second /proc/stat interval, some/full total delta >0 microseconds unsafe, malformed/missing refusal, typed journal, healthy and pressured real capture plus forced-pressure mutation. Existing policy spaces these one-second observations by cpuSampleIntervalSeconds=10 in admission and watchIntervalSeconds=15 in active work; source shows this is feasible without changing Mac thresholds.
changed_blockers_rechecked.LINUX-VISIBLE-PANEL-ORACLE: Addressed in plan: unique mapped owned X11 Chrome top-level window, non-minimized state, Browser.getWindowForTarget geometry, actual display pixels compared with selected SIDE_PANEL capture, and an unmapped-window negative mutation. Current CDP-only screenshot/optional window observation would not meet this oracle; plan explicitly makes those conditions refusal predicates.

blocking.finding: The revised route adds Linux to the existing job but does not explicitly adapt two unconditional Mac-only phases before browser work. The indexing phase exits unless RUNNER_OS is macOS and uses mdutil; all three readiness invocations call /usr/sbin/sysctl and /usr/sbin/iostat. A Linux pilot therefore stops before the guarded browser phase even when the new main resource sampler is correct.
blocking.fix: Freeze Linux handling for the indexing and readiness phases: retain exact Mac behavior; on Linux omit indexing and use a strict Linux readiness sampler with the same existing thresholds/three-healthy rule and measurement refusal. Exercise the actual workflow path through these gates before claiming pilot readiness.

blocking.finding: The plan requires genuine healthy and pressured Linux PSI interval evidence before enabling the Linux route, but offers a 'guarded pilot' as a source of that evidence. That pilot depends on the route being enabled. A local VM is allowed but no actual VM is identified; the stated current environment has no supported larger host or self-hosted runner. The precondition can therefore deadlock or be waived without anyone noticing.
evidence: /tmp/linux-native-capacity-plan-20261020.md:current evidence; Equivalent host guard and browser proof
blocking.fix: Name a concrete independent Linux source before route enable, such as an already-existing light Ubuntu CI job that captures genuine healthy and induced-pressure one-second /proc/stat+PSI pairs and validates the strict parser/refusal. Keep that evidence separate from the later headed native pilot; if the light capture cannot be obtained, retain Linux refusal.

verdict_limit: The changed PSI and X11 contracts are materially stronger, but the two route feasibility gaps must be closed before dispatch. No claim of Linux or product acceptance is made.
